+# mypy: allow-untyped-defs
+"""Source location formatting using an at-sign delimiter."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import inspect
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest.compat import get_real_func
+
+
+def at_sign_location(function, curdir: str | os.PathLike[str] | None = None) -> str:
+    """Like :func:`_pytest.compat.getlocation`, but formats the location as
+    ``filename@lineno`` instead of ``filename:lineno``."""
+    function = get_real_func(function)
+    fn = Path(inspect.getfile(function))
+    lineno = function.__code__.co_firstlineno
+    if curdir is not None:
+        try:
+            relfn = fn.relative_to(curdir)
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+        else:
+            return f"{relfn}@{lineno + 1}"
+    return f"{fn}@{lineno + 1}"

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest.at_sign_location import at_sign_location
+from _pytest.compat import getlocation
+
+
+def _func() -> None:
+    pass
+
+
+def test_at_sign_location_absolute() -> None:
+    expected = getlocation(_func)
+    path, _, lineno = expected.rpartition(":")
+    assert at_sign_location(_func) == f"{path}@{lineno}"
+
+
+def test_at_sign_location_relative() -> None:
+    curdir = Path(__file__).parent
+    assert at_sign_location(_func, curdir) == (
+        f"{Path(__file__).name}@{_func.__code__.co_firstlineno + 1}"
+    )
+
+
+def test_at_sign_location_unrelated_curdir(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    assert at_sign_location(_func, tmp_path) == (
+        f"{Path(__file__)}@{_func.__code__.co_firstlineno + 1}"
+    )
